description.fun: Seviper sharpens its blade-like tail on rocks and coats it with venom, and it has been at war with Zangoose for generations. It wraps around its foes to pin them in place before striking with poisoned fangs. Its Japanese name, Habunake, comes from the habu, a venomous snake. The Z of Zangoose and the S of Seviper may mirror each other on purpose.
description.guide: A Poison-type Pokémon based on a viper, with a venomous, blade-like tail. It is the sworn rival of Zangoose and the only pure Poison-type Pokémon with no evolutionary relatives. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A blade-tailed viper sworn to fight Zangoose forever
